## ConsoleClient interface

The Console client: one namespace per resource that has operations, plus the app's own commands. A client factory creates one from `consoleContract` in the app's `/contract` entry. Its type carries the contract's resource table, [ConsoleResources](./console_contract.consoleresources.md)<!-- -->, so references can be bound to it by resource; the brand has no runtime member.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface ConsoleClient extends ClientBrand<ConsoleResources>
```

**Extends:** [ClientBrand](./contracts.clientbrand.md)<!-- -->&lt;[ConsoleResources](./console_contract.consoleresources.md)<!-- -->&gt;
